learning: No additional learning applied this iteration.
rationale: The geometry proposal increases sensor count to 7 and shifts sensors forward and laterally to improve line detection and reduce steering oscillations. The race telemetry shows persistent line loss and oscillations, so the controller is adjusted to lower base speed and reduce PID gains to improve stability and responsiveness with the new sensor layout. Sensor weights are expanded to 7 sensors with stronger lateral weights to leverage the wider sensor spread. The observation request includes all key metrics to monitor line loss, control effort, and error for further tuning. This integrated design aims to reduce line loss events and steering oscillations, improving progress and completion on both oval and s-bend tracks, supporting better generalization.
